p: heavens: As witness of this people's ingratitude.
doctrine shall drop as the rain: He desires that he may speak to God's glory and that the people, as the green grass, may receive the dew of his doctrine.
Rock: Or mighty God; noting that only God is mighty, faithful and constant in his promise.
made thee: Not according to the common creation, but he has made you a new creature by his Spirit.
people according to the number of: When God by his providence divided the world, he lent for a time that portion to the Canaanites, which would later be an inheritance for all his people Israel.
fluttereth over her young: To teach them to fly.
earth: Meaning, of the land of Canaan, which was high in respect to Egypt.
honey out of the rock: That is, abundance of all things even in the very rocks.
But Jeshurun waxed fat: He shows what is the principal end of our vocation.
strange gods: By changing his service for their superstitions.
new gods that came newly up: Scripture calls new, whatever man invents, be the error ever so old.
sons: He calls them God's children, not to honour them, but to show them from what dignity they are fallen.
people: Which I have not favoured, nor given my law to them.
without: They shall be slain both in the field and at home.
behave themselves strangely: Rejoicing to see the godly afflicted, and attributing to themselves that which is wrought by God's hand.
consider their latter end: They would consider the happiness that was prepared for them, if they had obeyed God.
wine is the poison of dragons: The fruit of the wicked are as poison, detestable to God, and dangerous for man.
shut up: When neither strong nor weak in a manner remain.
lift up my hand to heaven: That is, I swear, read Ge 14:22.
blood of his servants: Where the blood of God's people is shed for their sins or trial of their faith, he promises to avenge it.
vain thing for you: For I will perform my promise to you, Isa 55:10.
sanctified me not in the midst: You were not earnest and constant to maintain my honour.
